conditions.description: The workflow uses pull_request_target for pull-request code review.
conditions.rationale: pull_request_target executes in the base repository security context, so untrusted head code must not be executed under that context.

conditions.description: The workflow explicitly checks out github.event.pull_request.head.sha.
conditions.rationale: This places attacker-controlled pull-request bytes in a workflow running with base-repository privileges.

conditions.description: The job grants contents: write and pull-requests: write while processing the untrusted head checkout.
conditions.rationale: Compromised pull-request code can act with write-capable repository permissions.

conditions.description: npm ci is run after checking out the untrusted pull-request head.
conditions.rationale: npm installation can execute lifecycle scripts defined by attacker-controlled package metadata.

conditions.description: The workflow explicitly disables OIDC token minting with id-token: none.
conditions.rationale: An inspector should not falsely claim that this workflow grants OIDC token permission.

conditions.description: The workflow grants only actions: read rather than actions: write.
conditions.rationale: The existing read-only Actions permission must not be reported as write permission.

conditions.description: Whether repository or organization secrets are configured and accessible to this workflow is not established by the workflow file.
conditions.rationale: Secret inventory and policy are external repository settings.

conditions.description: Whether branch protection or organization policy prevents consequential writes from this token is not established here.
conditions.rationale: Repository and organization enforcement require external evidence.

conditions.description: The workflow must not be cleared as safe for executing arbitrary fork pull-request code.
conditions.rationale: It checks out and runs the pull-request head in a pull_request_target job with write permissions.

conditions.description: The workflow must not be cleared as least-privileged for untrusted review execution.
conditions.rationale: Repository write scopes are present while untrusted code and package hooks are executed.
